data.title: Amazon Is in Talks to Buy AI Startup Decart, WSJ Reports
data.description: Amazon.com Inc. is in negotiations to acquire Decart AI, an artificial intelligence startup, in a deal that could be valued at around $7 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported.
